> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `serve: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance serve
```

Start the local web server hosting the browser editor, rule-violation viewer and reports/coverage viewer.

The server binds to localhost only and has no authentication. It is a single-user editing surface and must not be exposed beyond the local machine.
